values.description: API Gateway base URL (no trailing slash). Switch to the Local value for offline dev.
Basic Auth client id for the API Gateway credential check.
Basic Auth client secret. Mark as secret so Postman does not sync it to the cloud.
Computed at runtime by a pre-request script: Basic base64(clientId:clientSecret). Do not set manually.
Bearer token obtained after Auth/Login + Auth/MFA Verify. Set automatically by the test scripts in those requests.
Default member ID used in customer and admin requests. Corresponds to maya031 (Silver, 1500 pts, no MFA).
Captured from the Login response when the fraud engine issues an MFA challenge. Used by Auth/MFA Verify.
Captured from Admin/Decisions list. Used by Admin/Release Decision.
